tools.name: truncus_send
tools.description: Send a transactional email without waiting for the delivery outcome. The call hands the email to the sending provider and returns a `message_id` with `status: sent` once the provider has accepted it (`scheduled` when send_at is set); whether it reached the inbox is reported later — read it with truncus_get_email or truncus_list_events. Use this for fire-and-forget transactional sends (welcomes, receipts, password resets). For synchronous delivery confirmation use truncus_send_sync. The `from` address must be on a verified Truncus domain — list yours with truncus_list_domains.

from.description: Sender address. Must match a verified Truncus domain.

html.description: HTML body. Required unless template_id is provided.

template_id.description: Saved template ID. Mutually exclusive with html.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata stored with the email record.

tenant_id.description: Isolate suppression lists per tenant in multi-tenant applications.

send_at.description: ISO 8601 future datetime to schedule delivery (e.g. 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key tied to your business event (e.g. order-1234-receipt). Omit it and the server derives one deterministically from this call's arguments, so an identical retry is recognised as a duplicate and never sends twice. Supply your own when the same message may be built from differing arguments.

tools.name: truncus_send_sync
tools.description: Send a single transactional email and wait for the receiving mail server to accept it, on the same call. Returns the final delivery status — `delivered`, `bounced`, `complained`, `failed`, or `blocked` (Truncus refused the send before handing it to a provider: sending domain not found, not verified, paused or over its daily cap; sandbox recipient restriction; message type not matching the domain type; or all recipients suppressed — the response carries a `code`) — instead of just `queued`. If no outcome arrives within 25 seconds it returns `pending` with the `message_id` — check it later with truncus_get_email. Use this when the agent must verify the outcome before continuing (e.g., kicking off a flow only if the email actually landed).

from.description: Sender address. Must match a verified Truncus domain.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata stored with the email record.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key tied to your business event (e.g. order-1234-receipt). Omit it and the server derives one deterministically from this call's arguments, so an identical retry is recognised as a duplicate and never sends twice. Supply your own when the same message may be built from differing arguments.

tools.name: truncus_validate
tools.description: Run the pre-send deliverability checks (suppression, domain health, content quality, deliverability score) without sending. Returns `valid`, a `confidence_score` (0–1), the per-check results in `checks` — including `from_domain_healthy.dkim_status` (`pass`, `fail` or `unknown`); `from_domain_healthy.spf` and `.dmarc` reflect whether the domain is verified with Truncus, not a live DNS check — non-blocking `warnings`, and a `recommendation` (`safe_to_send`, `send_with_caution` or `do_not_send`). Use before truncus_send to catch issues early when generating email content from an LLM.

tools.name: truncus_get_email
tools.description: Look up a specific email by its Truncus ID. Returns the full send record plus the event timeline (queued, sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, complained). Use to verify outcome of an earlier send, debug deliverability issues, or read tracked engagement.

id.description: Email ID returned by truncus_send or truncus_send_sync.

tools.name: truncus_list_events
tools.description: Return the chronological event timeline for a single email — every state transition SES (or the configured provider) reports back. Use when the agent needs to surface "why did this email fail" or to wait for a specific event type.

email_id.description: Filter events for a specific email (required).

tools.name: truncus_get_stats
tools.description: Aggregated send/open/click/bounce/complaint counts across the account for a configurable lookback window. Use to surface "how is my domain doing" answers, or to gate further sends on bounce-rate health.

tools.name: truncus_list_domains
tools.description: List all domains attached to the account with verification status and per-domain stats (sent today, daily cap, bounce rate, complaint rate, health green/yellow/red). Use this before truncus_send to confirm which `from` addresses are usable.

tools.name: truncus_check_suppression
tools.description: Check whether a given recipient is on the account-wide (or tenant-scoped) suppression list. Always returns `email`, `suppressed`, `scope`, `reason` and `since`; a clean address is `suppressed: false` (HTTP 200, not a 404). Use to short-circuit sends to addresses that have previously bounced, complained, or unsubscribed.

tenant_id.description: Scope the check to a specific tenant.
